Overall Experience: Decent experience. You can visit for electronics, but better to confirm availability before going.

featured_reviews.name: Uzma Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at this store. I went to buy the Oppo F31 Pro (8GB/128GB) using my Bajaj EMI card. The salesperson asked me to meet the finance person on the first floor. After checking, he said my Bajaj finance was rejected.

I then requested him to check with IDFC finance. He asked me to wait for 15 minutes, but instead of actually checking, he later told me that since Bajaj was rejected, IDFC would also be rejected — without even trying. This felt very unprofessional and misleading.

After wasting my time, I went to Digi1 and bought the same phone on the same day using the same Bajaj EMI card, which clearly shows the issue was with their handling, not my eligibility.

Staff needs better training and honesty. Customers’ time should be respected.

featured_reviews.name: Curiouslyawed
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a store that I have shopped from a lot and visit often for many small or big shopping needs for electronics and digital products. Visited again today for checking out ACs. While the store has a good selection of brands, good display and decent number of employees, the service orientation was totally missing. Staff is helpful but is available only when you reach out for a specific need (so they are helpful only when and if you are buying). I walked through the whole store on a Monday morning when the store was not at all busy but noone acknowledged my presence until I asked about a product. So, I would buy from here if I have to buy a product, and I am in  the vicinity, and of course for the brand value of Reliance. But for service and customer centricity I would rate them an average hence, a 3 star. The only drive for staff members is their sales incentive.
